features: IP recording bandwidth 64-192 Mbps (64 Mbps default, about +8 Mbps per disabled analog channel)
Coax-channel analytics: PID / LCD / PD / sound detection / camera tampering / face detection / face recognition

Intelligent video analysis on IP channels (depending on IP camera model): perimeter intrusion detection (PID), line crossing detection (LCD), stationary object detection (SOD), pedestrian detection (PD), face detection, cross counting (CC), sound detection, camera tampering
notes: Standard inputs are 16 BNC + 8 IP; up to 24 IP channels when analog channels are disabled.
IP recording bandwidth and coax-channel analytics are taken from the user manual.
Alarm input count left out: the user manual states 16; urmet.de states 8.
Storage left out: urmet.de states 1 SATA HDD, max 8 TB; the user manual states max 2 SATA HDDs of 10 TB each.
Max output bandwidth left out: urmet.de states 96 Mbps; the user manual states 192 Mbps.
Power consumption left out: urmet.de states 10 W without HDD; the user manual states 20 W.
Power supply left out: urmet.de states 12 V DC 2 A; the user manual states 12 V / 5 A.
Ethernet speed left out: urmet.de states 10/100 Mbps; the user manual states 100/1000 Mbps.
Operating temperature left out: urmet.de states -10 to +55 C; the user manual states 0 to +40 C.
Dimensions and weight left out: urmet.de lists 300 x 53 x 227 mm; the user manual lists 380 x 50 x 340 mm; datasheet product data lists 380 x 340 x 53 mm, 3.46 kg.
Named in the Urmet S.p.A. NDAA Section 889 statement (main chipset), June 2023.
